thread:
Anna (PM): Quick sync — post-launch sidecar rollout. We have two customer-reported issues: dashboard latency spike + occasional 502s when sidecar is enabled. How should we prioritize? bug vs enhancement?
Jorge (Eng): Can you paste the errors? 502s are P0 if they're customer-facing.
Anna (PM): Logs in prod look noisy. We have 5 customers affected, two paying. Customer impact > threshold but recoverable via manual workaround.
Megan (QA): Repro steps from support:
• enable sidecar on org X
• run 10 concurrent requests
• see p99 jump, then 502 after ~30s
Megan (QA): Minimal reproducer attached in GH issue #1729.
Ritesh (Support): Confirmed. Customers see failures in the live dashboard, they filed tickets and escalation is on. One asked for ETA.
Jorge (Eng): Ok — my take: triage as P1 bug (service crashes), schedule a hotfix branch. Enhancement label for perf improvements after stabilization.
Anna (PM): Agree. Proposed plan: 1) Hotfix for the 502s (can we prioritize trunk -> canary -> prod today?) 2) Backlog groom a follow-on initiative: perf and UX polish for sidecar next sprint.
Jorge (Eng): I can cut a hotfix branch now. Will try to repro locally and get a patch. If it's an N+1 socket leak, quick revert might be faster.
Megan (QA): I'll run the reproducer in the staging cluster and post a test case. If flaky, I'll add a deterministic unit test.
Ritesh (Support): I'll send a customer note: temporary workaround: disable sidecar per org settings, and we will enable once fixed. Need copy for the message.
Anna (PM): Draft message: "We're investigating sidecar errors causing intermittent 502s. A workaround is to disable the sidecar temporarily. ETA for a patch: T+6-12h." Thoughts?
Jorge (Eng): Fine, T+6-12h feels realistic if nothing blocks. If we hit a kernel-level regression, might be longer.
DeployBot: deploy started: canary/sidecar-hotfix -> infra-1
DeployBot: canary succeeded (10m), rolling to prod
Megan (QA): Verified canary under load, p99 returned to normal and 502s not seen in 30m smoke. Passing QA for this hotfix.
Anna (PM): Nice. Action items: - Jorge: merge hotfix + postmortem link - Megan: attach test and QA signoff - Ritesh: send customer note and update tickets - Anna: groom follow-on epic for perf improvements (label: postlaunch-sidecar-enhance)
Ritesh (Support): Sent customer updates. One customer replied: "thanks, please keep us posted".
Anna (PM): Closing loop here. We'll groom the follow-on epic tomorrow 10:30am. If anything regresses, escalate to eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
